help[5]:
  Run `chrome-devtools-axi fill @g4:3_1 "text"` to fill the "Search Wikipedia" field
  Run `chrome-devtools-axi click @g4:1_6` to click the "Main menu" button
  Run `chrome-devtools-axi click @g4:1_2` to click the "Jump to content" link
  Run `chrome-devtools-axi scroll down` to scroll down
  Use `chrome-devtools-axi eval <expr>` for JS expressions. For multi-statement code, pass a function: `eval "() => { ...; return result }"`
